description:
Annualized internal rate of return of cashflows on actual calendar dates.

Actual/365 day count (matches Excel XIRR); base date is the earliest cashflow.

cashflows.description: Dated cashflows; needs at least one sign change. Outflows negative.

items.description: A single cashflow on a calendar date (for XNPV/XIRR).

amount.description: Cashflow amount; outflows negative, inflows positive.

name: xirr

all_irrs.description: Every real IRR found in (-100%, 1,000,000%], as decimals, ascending.

irr.description: Representative IRR as a decimal: per period for irr, annual for xirr. When not unique this is the smallest non-negative root (or the root nearest zero if all are negative); inspect all_irrs and is_unique, or use mirr() for a single value.

is_unique.description: True when exactly one IRR exists; when False, irr is one of several.

title: Internal Rate of Return (Dated Cashflows)
